text.p: Northern Telecom Inc said on Tuesday it is syndicating through a group of major financial institutions about $1.1 billion of its $1.3 billion vendor credit facility with Sprint Spectrum LP.
Sprint PCS, a partnership of Sprint Corp, Tele-Communications Inc, Cox Communications Inc and Comcast Corp, will market Sprint Spectrum's personal communication services, or PCS.
The syndication of participation rights and loan assignments is expected to be completed in early 1997, the company said.
Nortel is a major provider of goods and services in the construction of Sprint Spectrum's network.

The company said about $600 million of the syndicated financing has been committed to by such financial institutions or their affiliates. The Export Development Corp of Canada is also expected to play a major role in the deal, Nortel said.
The company said the estimated $200 million of the remaining loans are expected to be assigned to a supplier under an existing commitment to provide related financing to Nortel.
